items.name: SyncRun

request_key.description: Server-derived job, actor, and request UUID identity. Legacy rows may omit it.

job_type.description: Bounded explicit external-provider operation represented by this run.

request_id.description: Client-generated UUID for one explicit authenticated request. Legacy rows may omit it.

request_fingerprint.description: Server-derived scope fingerprint used to reject request-id reuse across targets.

target_key.description: Optional stable server-derived operation target. It serializes distinct request UUIDs aimed at the same side-effect target.

initiator_id.description: Id of the user, agent, or workflow that initiated the run.

initiator_user_id.description: The authenticated user who started the run, if any (null for scheduled/workflow runs).

obo_user_id.description: On-Behalf-Of user the run was scoped to, when an agent/admin acted for a specific user.

attempt_number.description: Monotonic stale-recovery attempt for this request key.

active_claim_key.description: Immutable claim allowed to finalize the current attempt.

claim_checked_at.description: Latest conditional active-claim fence immediately before provider I/O or a durable side effect.

result_payload.description: Safe response payload retained so a completed request UUID can be replayed without provider I/O.

provider_results.description: Per-provider, per-campaign outcome. A failure here does not compromise other providers.

currency.description: ISO currency for amount_discovered, or UNSPECIFIED for legacy owner-reported records without currency provenance.

total_discovered.description: Backward-compatible USD-only discovered total. Other currencies are never converted or added here.

discovered_totals.description: Informational external totals grouped by currency without conversion.

total_held.description: Verified funds physically settled into Interplanetary Fund-controlled payment/holding accounts. External observed balances are excluded until a provider/bank settlement is verified.

campaign_totals.description: Per-campaign balances from the Base44 treasury ledger.

items.name: User

role.description: The role of the user in the app

username.description: The unique display handle the user chose at registration, shown across the Interplanetary Fund social feed and profile.

banner_tier.description: Reward banner tier earned by posting on the Interplanetary Fund social feed. Higher tiers unlock premium profile banners and top-feed placement.

social_score.description: Accumulated reward points from social posting activity. Determines banner tier and top-placement eligibility.

onboarding_completed.description: Whether the user has completed the intelligent onboarding flow.

onboarding.description: Saved onboarding selections (fundraising goal, platforms, automation preferences).

comm_prefs.description: Notification delivery preferences for messages from organizers.

ai_connection_consent.description: Revocable owner authorization for AI-assisted platform connection setup. Does not grant provider permissions or payment authority.

ai_publishing_consent.description: Explicit, revocable authorization for AI-assisted external publishing. Automatic publishing must fail closed unless granted is true.

subscription_tier.description: Active AI subscription tier id (from the plans catalog). 'free' when none.

stripe_subscription_id.description: Stripe subscription ID verified from Checkout, bound to this user for renewals and cancellation.

paypal_subscription_id.description: Provider verified PayPal billing subscription. Never populated from a browser-only success redirect.

premium_trial_started_at.description: Permanent record that the one-time card-free introductory trial was redeemed.

premium_day_pass_expires_at.description: Server-verified end of the 24-hour Stripe premium day pass.

stripe_day_pass_checkout_id.description: Most recently verified Stripe Checkout Session credited for a premium pass.

stripe_day_pass_payment_intent.description: PaymentIntent behind the current premium pass, for refund/dispute revocation.

account_deletion_pending.description: True once account deletion has been authorized and is in progress. The app revokes access for a pending account; data cleanup and final deletion/anonymization run idempotently so a retry after a mid-process failure resumes cleanly.

account_status.description: Lifecycle status of the account. 'disabled' blocks all sensitive actions server-side (assertActiveAccount). Pending deletion is tracked separately by account_deletion_pending; a deleted account is simply absent from the store.

ai_obo_consent.description: Canonical, revocable IFund-wide authorization for AI agents to act on the user's behalf across connected platform features. Provider capabilities and connection health still limit what can actually be performed.

first_paid_subscription_at.description: Earliest provider-verified first paid subscription; immutable across renewals for social posting priority.
